summary: Credo Ventures says it backs the most ambitious founders from Central and Eastern Europe and its global diaspora, pre-everything, and has led rounds since 2009. Its homepage lists how it operates: backing exceptional people rather than a thesis, leading pre-seed rounds, checks of $1,000,000 to $5,000,000, and hands-on work with technical founders, with more than 100 companies backed. An info email is published. Sector focus and a street address are not stated on the pages reviewed.

investmentEvidence.fact: The homepage states more than 100 companies backed and two decacorns; individual companies are listed on the portfolio page without dates on the homepage.

sources.title: Homepage: CEE focus, pre-seed leading, check size, operating principles and contact email
